 Belgium vs. Italy - Head-to-head record
 Italy has held the upper hand in recent history against Belgium, consistently proving a formidable opponent for the Red Devils over the past decade. The Azzurri have a storied past in their competitive fixtures against Belgium.
 Looking at their last six meetings, Italy clinched four victories and one draw . However, Belgium’s only win during this period was a convincing 2-0 triumph in their most recent UEFA Nations League encounter. This significant result adds an extra layer of intrigue to the upcoming Belgium vs. Italy clash.
 Belgium’s victory in the reverse fixture suggests they have found a method to counter Italian dominance. While the historical Belgium vs. Italy stats still lean towards the visitors, the home side will carry considerable confidence into this match, making for a tightly contested and unpredictable game.

 Belgium - Searching for some consistency
 Here is a closer look at Belgium’s current situation. We will highlight the team’s momentum, their latest displays, and how they might approach this new test against Italy.
 Recent form
 Belgium’s journey in the UEFA Nations League has been a rollercoaster, with three wins and two defeats in their five group matches. Their most recent outing was a heavy 4-1 loss against France, a result that raises questions about their defensive solidity. This inconsistency has been a recurring theme for the Red Devils heading into the final game.
 At home, their record in this competition is perfectly balanced with one win and one defeat. A significant boost for the team is the absence of any injuries or suspensions. Having a fully fit squad gives the manager plenty of options and tactical flexibility, which could prove decisive in a tight contest.
 The team will rely on the creative genius of Kevin De Bruyne, who has two goals and an assist in the campaign. Dodi Lukébakio provides another attacking threat, also with two goals to his name. With their key players fit, Belgium will be determined to bounce back from their previous loss and finish on a high.

 Italy - Showing some strong form
 Let’s review Italy’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s momentum, their expectations, and standout players for this crucial UEFA Nations League match.
 Recent form
 Italy enters this UEFA Nations League match in strong form, having accumulated seven points from four group stage games. Their away performances have been particularly impressive, remaining unbeaten with a win and a draw on the road while conceding only two goals. This resilience highlights their solid campaign.
 The Azzurri showcase a significant attacking threat, scoring eight goals in the competition. Young attacker Francesco Esposito stands out with two goals and an assist. Defender Alessandro Bastoni has also contributed impressively, finding the back of the net twice.
 Crucially, Italy boasts a full squad with no injured or suspended players for this encounter. This complete availability provides the manager with excellent tactical flexibility and strong options. Having their main men fit will be vital as they aim for a positive outcome in the Belgium vs. Italy clash.

 Predictions for Belgium vs. Italy - Italy with a safety net
 Belgium will be confident after their recent win over Italy, but the visitors are in strong form. With attacking talent on both sides, there’s a good chance of a goal being scored in both halves.
 This fixture is finely balanced, making a clear winner hard to pick. Italy’s solid away record clashes with Belgium’s home advantage, so backing either team to win could be a wise move for this encounter.
 Despite the close contest, Italy’s more consistent campaign gives them a slight edge. Therefore, our main prediction is for an Italy win on the “Draw No Bet” market , which provides a valuable safety net.
